item.title: Time Time Conversion
item.description:
Create a function that converts 12-hour time to 24-hour time or vice versa. Return the output as a string. Examples
convertTime("12:00 am")
output = "0:00"

convertTime("6:20 pm")
output = "18:20"

convertTime("21:00")
output = "9:00 pm"

convertTime("5:05")
output ="5:05 am"
Notes- A 12-hour time input will be denoted with an am or pm suffix.
